title: brunellia integrifolia subsp. mollis
intro: Brunellia integrifolia subsp. mollis, commonly known as Mollis Brunellia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Brunelliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Mollis Brunellia include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for medicinal use.
